name: dayweave
description: Inspect and simulate DayWeave schedules, then submit simulation-bound proposals for device review.

interface.shortDescription: Simulate plans and submit proposals for device review.
interface.longDescription: Read your DayWeave schedule, explore what-if plans, and submit simulation-bound typed or advisory proposals to the Suggestions Inbox. Only an authorized DayWeave device can preview or apply them; the plugin never changes canonical items.
defaultPrompt: Review today's DayWeave schedule and explain the main conflicts.
Simulate a realistic plan for my unfinished work without changing anything.
Simulate this plan and submit a DayWeave proposal for device review; do not apply it.
